KEN.note: Document states nothing on civil-servant digital training.

facts.fact: The Communications Authority's Director General says the Universal Service Fund has connected nearly 800,000 people in underserved areas, 886 secondary schools, 56 public libraries and 42 law courts.

KEN.note: Digital skilling is named only as a planned focus, with no programme or count.
The strategy is the regulator's universal service fund strategy, not a national digital strategy.
Persons with disabilities are named only as a target of planned skilling.
The KSh 40 billion figure is a strategy size, with no budget year, line or statement of own-resource financing.
Nothing on government staff running systems.
Says only broad stakeholder input, with no named consultation, hearing or opinion given.
A count of 886 schools connected, not a share of secondary schools; no curriculum statement.
Teacher uploading school records is an illustration, not a described system.
